title: Get the last item with at(-1)
why_it_matters: It's shorter, and harder to get wrong than length - 1.
explanation: Square brackets can't take negative indexes, so the old way to get the last item was length - 1. The at method accepts negative numbers and counts from the end. at(-1) is the last item, at(-2) the one before it.
try_it: Use at(-1) to get the last character of 'DevTok'. Strings have at too.
